ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revision effective 1 January 2025); Administrative Measures for Beneficial Ownership Information Registration (PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020); relevant PBOC anti-money laundering regulations on customer due diligence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Foreign-Invested Enterprise business license) of the proposed WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) or its local market supervision bureau
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: notarize the SAMR-issued copy at a Chinese notary office, then obtain an Apostille from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China; do not add consular legalization after the Apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the Taiwan parent/investor company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Section (Taiwan)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization: Taiwanese notarial certification followed by Cross-Strait Notarization Verification and then legalization by the competent Chinese consular mechanism; no Hague Apostille is available because Taiwan is not a Hague Apostille Convention party.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing formation and UBO filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan parent company board of directors or authorized shareholder meeting
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization track: Taiwanese notarization plus Cross-Strait legalization/verification; use the same parallel track as all Taiwan-origin documents and do not combine with Apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Memorandum and Articles) of the proposed WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporation counsel and SAMR filing copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: notarize the SAMR-stamped final text, then Apostille by Chinese competent authority for use in any Hague member state; no consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the investor or the WFOE pre-registration account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan issuing bank or counterpart international bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization for Taiwan-issued letters: Taiwanese notarization and cross-strait verification; for a letter issued in a Hague member state, use Apostille alone. Never chain Apostille and consular legalization sequentially.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation, counsel must run enhanced due diligence on all UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, China's MOFCOM and MEE-related export controls and sanctions lists, and domestic PEP databases. All individuals holding 25% or more of ownership or voting rights must be separately screened. If any UBO is a politically exposed person, full source-of-wealth verification and senior management approval must be documented. Negative media screening and real-time sanctions alerts are required, with false positives escalated and resolved in writing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (gsxt.gov.cn) and the SAMR Enterprise Name Registration Service portal (online name reservation and clearance module)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: WFOE names must be registered in simplified Chinese characters and follow the four-tier statutory structure: administrative division + distinctive trade name + industry/operating characteristics + company legal form. An English transliteration is optional and must not mislead; where a foreign parent name is used, the Chinese trade name must be the official phonetic transliteration and must be approved by SAMR. Pinyin may be used in English correspondence but cannot replace the Chinese legal name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Central, National, State, Chinese, Sino or administrative division names implying government authority
Bank, Securities, Insurance, Trust, Fund, Payment, or other licensed financial terms absent central regulator approval
University, College, Hospital, or similar regulated professional terms absent ministry approval
International Terms such as International or Global if the entity cannot satisfy the name-mechanical criteria or approval requirements
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the reserved name is rejected, the applicant must file an administrative reconsideration petition with the SAMR authority that rejected the name within 15 days of the written rejection. Attach the original rejection notice, the proposed name structure, trademark search evidence, and a memorandum proving no conflict with registered or protected names. If the authority upholds rejection, an administrative lawsuit may be filed with the competent People's Court within 15 days of the reconsideration decision. The process may also be escalated to the higher market supervision bureau where state-level approval is involved.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the WFOE registered address. SAMR requires a fixed in-country address; local tax authorities reject virtual addresses because the tax registration, invoice collection, and bookkeeping must be legally linked to the registered office. Chinese banks, under PBOC AML/CDD circulars, will refuse basic deposit accounts for shell-like virtual addresses, especially for digital licensing businesses such as ISIC 5920 / NAICS 512240. A physical shared-workplace or government-licensed business park address with an actual desk, lease, and an on-site authorized representative may be accepted, but a private mailbox cannot satisfy the requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) compliant company name plate at the registered address; (2) original lease, rent receipts, and utility invoices; (3) physical books, contracts, invoices and records; (4) computer equipment and log files supporting the stock-music licensing activity; (5) employee presence or an authorized person able to answer tax or registry officials; (6) evidence that bank account statements match reported revenue streams. Quantified risk: Medium-high; for the first 24 months there is a 45-65% probability of at least one unannounced municipal tax or SAMR inspection; a wholly virtual operation raises the risk to near 100% of adverse findings and potential deregistration.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: The Company Act of Taiwan (公司法), as amended since 2009, particularly Articles 128, 129, 154, 156, 161, 172, 193, 202, 208 and 387; the Company Registration Regulations; the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; and the Standard for Company Name Pre-Review and Business Scope Approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan - Company Registration Division, in coordination with the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Company Establishment (company establishment registration form) together with the Articles of Incorporation and all required annexes, filed under Article 387 of the Taiwan Company Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a Taiwan limited liability company since the 2009 amendments. The foreign shareholder may set a paid-up capital amount adequate for the business plan, as stated in the Articles of Incorporation. The subscribed capital must be remitted from overseas through a designated foreign exchange bank, and the bank's inbound remittance certificate must evidence payment before incorporation registration is completed. Taiwan does not require a blocked escrow or escrow-style capital account; the remitted funds are simply held in the company-designated New Taiwan Dollar capital account and may be used only after registration in accordance with the approved business scope.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF TAIWAN ______ MUSIC LICENSING LTD.

WHEREAS the Company is to be incorporated in Taiwan as a wholly foreign-owned limited company; WHEREAS the sole foreign shareholder has applied for or received investment approval from the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs; and WHEREAS the Board considers it necessary to approve the formation, capital, banking, office and officer matters required to establish the Company.

1. Convening and Quorum. The undersigned sole director of Taiwan ______ Music Licensing Ltd. (the Company), acting in accordance with Articles 192, 202 and 208 of the Taiwan Company Act, constitutes a legally constituted Board. By unanimous written consent, all Board action taken by this resolution is as valid and binding as if passed at a duly convened and noticed meeting, and any requirement of prior notice is hereby waived.

2. Adoption of Formation Instruments. Resolved, that the proposed Articles of Incorporation, the business plan for the royalty-free stock music licensing platform, and the application forms prepared for submission to the Department of Commerce of the Ministry of Economic Affairs are hereby approved, adopted and confirmed. The statutory representative is directed to execute and file the Company Establishment Registration Application and all ancillary instruments necessary to obtain the Company Registration Certificate.

3. Subscription and Payment of Share Capital. Resolved, that the Company shall issue and allot to its sole foreign shareholder the entire registered share capital of NT$[____], divided into [____] ordinary shares of NT$[____] per share. The shareholder is authorised to subscribe for all such shares and to pay the subscription amount in cash or equivalent foreign exchange remittance after receipt of the investment approval. No share shall be deemed issued until the paid-in amount is credited and evidenced by the bank remittance certificate, and no share shall be issued for services rendered.

4. Banking Resolution. Resolved, that the Company shall open current and deposit accounts with [insert bank name and branch] and that the general manager and the statutory representative, acting singly, are hereby authorised to sign account-opening forms, execute checks, negotiate foreign exchange and give banking instructions, provided that transactions above NT$[____] require joint signature or prior Board approval as stated in the bank mandate.

5. Registered Office. Resolved, that the registered office of the Company shall be at [address], Taiwan, which address is adopted as the statutory address for service of summons, notices and governmental correspondence.

6. Statutory Officer Appointments. Resolved, that [name] is appointed Chairperson and statutory representative of the Company, and that [name] is appointed General Manager and Company Secretary, such appointments effective upon the Company's registration. The officers so appointed shall have authority to operate payment platforms, execute music licences, open payment gateway accounts and maintain the books and records of the Company.

7. Delegation and Governance. Resolved, that the Board delegates to the General Manager all day-to-day operational authority within a single-transaction limit of NT$[____], subject to applicable law. Minutes, the share register and financial records shall be maintained at the registered office and be open for inspection as required by the Taiwan Company Act.

This Resolution may be certified as a true, complete and operative copy for counterparties, banks, licensors and regulators.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Pre-Review and Articles of Incorporation Drafting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA One-Stop Business Service Portal under the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a company name pre-review application through the MOEA One-Stop Business Service Portal so that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to any existing Taiwanese legal entity. The application must select the exact business scope line for ISIC 5920, namely technical sound recording, music publishing, commercial soundscape licensing and digital delivery of royalty-free stock music, so that the later registration is not challenged as exceeding the approved scope. If the foreign investor is a company, its authenticated constitutional documents must be included so that the applicant's legal existence is shown at the time of pre-review. A power of attorney should be notarially certified or legalized before being uploaded unless the process is executed by a Taiwan-licensed attorney who can certify signatures.
required_dossiers: Proposed English and Chinese company names
Exact business scope description for ISIC 5920
Investor identity evidence (passport or certificate of incorporation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA rejects or queries the name, the applicant must file a written explanation and an alternative name proposal within 14 days through the same portal. If the name is still refused, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days from delivery of the refusal decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval from the Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the name approval is obtained, file the Application for Investment by Foreign Nationals with the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs in Taiwan. The application must establish the foreign shareholder's 100% ownership of the proposed Taiwan limited company and state that the investment amount will be paid in cash. Annex a detailed business plan explaining the global royalty-free audio licensing marketplace, subscription collectives, royalty payment architecture, Stripe and PayPal payment rails, and the absence of physical manufacturing facilities. Submit the foreign investor's certificate of incorporation, good standing certificate, audited financial statements, identity documents of ultimate beneficial owners, and the notarized power of attorney. The Commission will issue an investment approval letter, which is a condition precedent to the foreign exchange remittance.
required_dossiers: Detailed business plan for digital music licensing
Certificate of incorporation and good standing of foreign investor
Audited financial statements of foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a notification of incompleteness, the applicant has 30 days to supplement. If approval is denied due to restricted business scope, the applicant may appeal to the Executive Yuan within 30 days after the decision or re-file after narrowing the business plan to exclude restricted activities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance and Designated Foreign Exchange Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated Foreign Exchange Bank in Taiwan supervised by the Central Bank of Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Take the Investment Commission approval letter and the company name approval to a designated foreign-exchange bank in Taiwan and open a pre-incorporation New Taiwan Dollar account under the intended company name. Complete the Foreign Exchange Remittance Application for Investment, identify the individual ultimate beneficial owner for bank KYC and AML checks, and instruct the overseas investor to wire the subscribed capital. The bank will execute the inward remittance, issue an inbound remittance certificate and record the transaction with the Central Bank's Foreign Exchange Data System. No statutory escrow or blocked account is required under Taiwan law; however, the remitted capital is designated as paid-in capital and must not be returned to the investor before company registration. The remittance certificate becomes the definitive proof of paid-up capital for the incorporation registration.
required_dossiers: Passport and identity documents of beneficial owners
Bank account opening forms and specimen signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the designated bank refuses the remittance due to KYC or AML deficiencies, complete an enhanced due diligence questionnaire and provide a bank reference. If the refusal persists, select another designated foreign-exchange bank. Any foreign exchange shortage is cured by adjusting the remitted amount to reflect the bank's buying rate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Registration with the Department of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan - Company Registration Division (One-Stop Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the company establishment registration application to the Department of Commerce through the One-Stop Portal or the Taipei Company Registration Office. The application must include the approved Articles of Incorporation, name pre-review certificate, Investment Commission approval, bank inward remittance certificate, consent to serve of directors and the statutory representative, registered office lease, and a copy of the company seal impression card. Verify that the company name, business scope, capital amount and officer information are exactly consistent with the foreign investment approval; any inconsistency will cause rejection. If any director cannot sign before the registry, enclose a notarized declaration made in Taiwan or at a Taiwan overseas mission. Pay the incorporation registration fee and obtain the Company Registration Certificate.
required_dossiers: Consent to serve for director and statutory representative
Registered office lease or consent of owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Department of Commerce returns the registration for correction, correct the defects within 15 days and re-submit. If the application is rejected on substantive grounds, appeal the disposition to the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days, or file a new application after curing the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Uniform Invoice Setup and Operational Compliance Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Regional National Taxation Bureau under the Ministry of Finance, Taiwan, together with local labor insurance and health insurance authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Company Registration Certificate is issued, apply to the regional National Taxation Bureau for establishment of the taxpayer account, business tax registration and Uniform Invoice registration. For a digital audio licensing company, sales to Taiwan businesses are generally subject to five-percent value-added tax and must be reported in the monthly VAT return, while export of licensing services may support zero-rated treatment if the contracts and invoices evidence export. File the designation of the responsible person and employee registration under the Labor Insurance Act, National Health Insurance Act and Employee Labor Pension Act. Complete the municipal office fire safety self-inspection form and keep the landlord's current fire safety inspection certificate on file before commencing operations. No environmental impact assessment or industrial civil defense permit is required because no manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing activity is carried out.
required_dossiers: Company and responsible person seal cards
Registered office lease and fire safety inspection certificate
VAT filing and digital export services documentation
Labor insurance and health insurance employee registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the National Taxation Bureau queries business-tax registration, submit the lease, invoices and e-invoice configuration within 10 business days. If a tax assessment is disputed, seek a revised assessment under the Taxpayer Rights Protection Act. If worker insurance enrollment is challenged, correct employee records with retroactive effect before any inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - no industrial licensing authority has jurisdiction because the operation is a pure digital royalty-free music licensing business with no physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing facilities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - ISIC 5920 royalty-free sound recording and music licensing in Taiwan does not require a sectoral industrial operating permit; only standard company registration and tax/business registration are required. If a physical recording studio is added later, local premises registration and fire-safety clearance may become necessary, but that is outside the current scope.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - no environmental protection agency review is triggered; if a physical facility is later added, the Taiwan Environmental Protection Administration and the local environmental protection bureau would become relevant.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Environmental Registration not required - the current activity is digital music licensing with no land development, no construction, no industrial wastewater, no combustion emission source and no hazardous waste generation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero process wastewater, zero VOC emissions and zero hazardous waste. Ordinary office computer equipment must comply with Taiwan electrical safety standards, and general office waste must be collected in accordance with local solid waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for industrial civil-defense fire permits; however, the lessor of the registered office must provide a valid fire-safety inspection certificate under the Taiwan Fire Services Act, maintain emergency evacuation routes, and ensure workplace safety compliance for general office use under the Occupational Safety and Health Act.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (MOF), National Taxation Bureau (NTB); electronic filing portal: e-Tax Digital Service Platform (https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Reserve the intended company name with the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA). 2. Submit the WFOE incorporation application to MOEA, including the foreign investment approval, Articles of Incorporation, and capital contribution evidence. 3. After MOEA approval, file the Business Tax Registration Application with the District National Taxation Bureau within 15 days. 4. Obtain the Unified Business Number (UBIN) and Business Tax Registration Certificate; the UBIN serves as the sole Tax Identification Number (TIN). 5. Register for the e-Invoice service and obtain the taxpayer digital certificate. 6. Appoint a tax agent or branch manager as the local tax representative for all filings. 7. Notify the Central Bank for foreign exchange settlement account setup, if applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; Taiwan does not have check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regimes for limited liability companies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: TWD 40,000 average monthly sales of services, equivalent to annual TWD 480,000; for foreign electronic service suppliers to Taiwanese consumers, mandatory Business Tax registration applies if annual sales exceed TWD 480,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Uniform Invoice (e-invoice) issuance for all B2B and B2C taxable supplies; e-invoice data must be transmitted to the Ministry of Finance E-Invoice Service Platform using the prescribed API and taxpayer digital certificate. Filing is bi-monthly with no separate real-time fiscal clearance or anti-fraud digital stamp.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act applies to the sale of digital audio licensing and subscription services to foreign enterprises/individuals for consumption outside Taiwan, with revenue earned in foreign currency and supported by an export invoice.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Zero-rated Uniform Invoice (no customs declaration requirement for intangible services)
Exported Service Agreement or Customer Order identifying the foreign buyer
Foreign Exchange Receipt Certificate (FIRC) or Bank Foreign Currency Settlement Statement
Payment Gateway Settlement Report (Stripe/PayPal) showing offshore remittance
Offshore Consumption Evidence (customer IP/address records or contract terms)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Within a 5-year audit window, the NTB may deny zero-rating, retroactively assess 5% Business Tax plus interest, and impose penalties of 1 to 10 times the evaded tax for fraudulent claims under the Business Tax Act. Criminal liability under the Tax Collection Act may apply in cases of intentional evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC); State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China for the mainland WFOE and cross-strait FX filings
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Taiwan jurisdiction operates a managed, report-oriented foreign-exchange regime in which the New Taiwan dollar is not freely convertible on the capital account. Current-account items such as royalty-free music licence fees, subscription revenues and trade-related service payments are generally convertible through authorized banks, provided the underlying transaction is genuine, the client passes AML/KYC screening and the payment is accompanied by the relevant invoices, contracts and tax declarations. Capital-account items, including inbound shareholder equity injections, inbound loans, capital redemption and repatriation of profits, are subject to pre-registration, approval or quota restrictions administered by the CBC and, for mainland-related ownership, by Taiwan's Investment Commission and SAFE registration mechanisms. Export proceeds are required to return to the Taiwan banking system within the prescribed regulatory window and must be reported through the CBC's Foreign Exchange Reporting system; Taiwan does not currently mandate a fixed percentage surrender of every export receipt, but any NT-dollar conversion must be executed through an Authorized Bank. For the mainland WFOE, SAFE applies strict capital-account verification and current-account authenticity examinations; profit and royalty remittances across the Taiwan Strait need audited financial statements, withholding tax payment certificates and matching purpose-of-payment codes. Liquidity planning must therefore keep CNY and NTD treasury pools separate and only move cash across the strait on documented trade, dividend or approved capital events.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For the stock-music licensing operation, export proceeds from the sale of royalty-free licences, subscriptions and audio sample contracts are service exports. The entity must repatriate the foreign-exchange revenue into the domestic banking system within 180 days from the earlier of the service completion date and the contractual payment due date, and must report the receipt to the CBC through the Authorized Bank via the standard foreign-exchange declaration. There is no mandatory fixed conversion ratio in Taiwan or mainland China for legitimate current-account service exports, but the bank will record and verify the export invoice, the signed licence agreement, delivery proof and the payment processor settlement report, and will require any conversion into NTD or CNY to be made at the licensed bank with correct purpose-of-remittance classification.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account (NTD and USD)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Mega International Commercial Bank Co., Ltd.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary treasury; acceptable only as an ancillary payment collection node for card-present and card-not-present subscription revenue. Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission and the CBC prohibit unlicensed offshore digital EMIs, including Wise, Revolut, Airwallex, Stripe Treasury and similar wallet operators, from holding NTD deposits or providing domestic account numbers to a Taiwan-incorporated entity. Stripe and PayPal may be used as upstream payment gateways to capture royalty-free music subscription and sample-download revenue, but their settlement balances must be swept to a licensed Taiwan bank account through a designated payment account or SWIFT transfer. The entity must not maintain its operating liquidity in an offshore EMI before or after FX conversion, because such routing would breach bank reporting duties, obscure the source of funds and trigger mandatory AML escalation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A statutory director, direct beneficial owner or a bank-approved senior officer holding a notarized board resolution and power of attorney must physically attend the initial account-opening interview at a Taiwan branch. Remote consular proxy opening is not standard; it is accepted by only a limited number of tier-1 banks and only where the power of attorney has been notarized in Taiwan or authenticated by the relevant overseas mission or cross-strait authentication channel. Video KYC may be used to supplement the interview, but it cannot replace the required in-branch appearance for the first corporate account opening of a cross-border WFOE structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity and nominee-style ownership across the China/Taiwan cross-strait chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Taiwan company registration extract, Investment Commission or MOF foreign-investment approval certificate, full UBO declaration identifying all natural persons holding 10% or more or exercising control, passport copies of all UBOs, board resolutions appointing signatories, corporate organization chart, and third-party bank statements proving the lawful origin of the initial capital contribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue mismatch between a low-ticket royalty-free music marketplace and the high-volume small-value card flows from Stripe and PayPal
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of PayPal and Stripe merchant payout reports, standard licence terms of use and subscription agreements, royalty calculation logic and sample licence certificates, refund and chargeback ledger, bank settlement statements showing the net sweep amounts, and a business-model narrative separating B2B commercial soundscape licensing from B2C self-serve subscription revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unregistered or undocumented inbound capital injection from the cross-strait shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE or Taiwan Investment Commission registration/approval certificate, CPA-issued capital verification report, bank-issued foreign-exchange settlement voucher and FDI debit notice, certified source-of-funds evidence for each shareholder, group financing or equity contribution agreement, and a board-approved funding plan confirming the exact equity or loan character of every inbound wire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, export-control and prohibited end-user exposure in the digital music distribution chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Restricted-party screening report for all payment beneficiaries, commercial counterparties and major subscribers; geolocation, IP and device logs showing no sanctioned-jurisdiction use; licence agreements containing anti-money laundering and anti-sanctions covenants; downstream licensor due-diligence questionnaires; and evidence that the royalty-free catalogue contains no assets derived from blocked or sanctioned persons.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For a mainland-incorporated WFOE funded by the Taiwan-side parent, the remitter must first obtain the applicable Investment Commission approval and the mainland entity must complete SAFE FDI registration. The Taiwan bank will send the capital remittance over SWIFT MT103 using the CBC-approved purpose code for investment and quoting the SAFE/FDI registration reference; the mainland beneficiary bank credits the dedicated capital escrow account, issues the FDI debit notice and foreign-exchange settlement voucher, and an independent CPA prepares

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Annual Income Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (MOF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 through May 31 of the following calendar year; e-filing may extend the final date to June 1
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers 3% additional income tax for each full month of delay with a cumulative ceiling of 30% of the tax assessed; willful non-filing may add a fixed fine of NTD 10,000-50,000. Interest at the 1-year postal savings rate accrues on underpayments. Persistent non-filing leads to tax levy and ultimately to the freezing or dissolution of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Company Annual Financial Statements and Business Report Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual shareholders meeting must be held by 30 June; audited financial statements and business report must be filed within 30 days after shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MOEA may order responsible persons to file within a fixed term; noncompliance subjects each responsible officer to a fine of NTD 10,000-50,000. Repeated failures constitute grounds under the Taiwan Company Act for administrative dissolution or strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholders Meeting Resolution and Minutes Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Commerce, MOEA and the local commercial registration authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after each shareholders meeting; the annual ordinary meeting must be held no later than 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A fine of NTD 10,000-50,000 is imposed on the chairperson or responsible person for late or non-filing; continuing default may trigger registration revocation or administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Registration Renewal and Registered Office Confirmation Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: City or County Commercial Registration Office and MOEA through the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the registration anniversary of incorporation, but no later than 30 June each year; any change in registered office or board members must be filed within 15 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to keep the statutory registration current results in fines of NTD 10,000-50,000 per occurrence; after an administrative order and continued default, MOEA may strike off the company from the Commercial Registration File.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (MOF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fifteen days after the end of each three-month period: 15 January, 15 April, 15 July, and 15 October
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Overdue returns trigger additional tax per month and late-filing fines; misreporting penalties range from 1 to 10 times the underpaid tax. Tax authorities may suspend or dismantle the business registration after recurring defaults.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Withholding Tax and Employee Remuneration Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (MOF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before 31 January of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A fine of NTD 1,500-7,500 per statement applies; the company responsible person and payroll secretary may be jointly penalized. Repeated omission can lead to a comprehensive tax audit escalation and court-ordered seizure.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit is legally mandatory if (1) paid-in capital exceeds NTD 30,000,000 (approximately USD 1,000,000); (2) annual operating revenue or total sales exceeds NTD 50,000,000 (approximately USD 1,670,000); (3) the entity is a public company supervised by the Financial Supervisory Commission; (4) the entity operates in financial, insurance, or securities industries; (5) the Articles of Association require an audit; or (6) the shareholder resolution requests a certified audit. Additional turnover and balance-sheet triggers apply under the Business Entity Accounting Act and the Company Act enforcement rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Public companies must apply International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission. Non-public companies may apply Taiwan SME Accounting Standards or ROC GAAP, but all financial statements must conform to the Business Entity Accounting Act and the Taiwan Company Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not maintain a public UBO registry, but every limited company must maintain an internal Control and Ownership Register and deliver a shareholder and beneficial-owner confirmation to MOEA within 30 days of any share transfer or change in ownership. Annually, the company secretary must reconfirm ownership information in the shareholders meeting minutes and update the register before the AGM. Any 30-day reporting window for shareholding transfers is strictly enforced under the commercial registration rules.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for qualified High/New Technology Enterprises; effective 5% rate for Small Low-Profit Enterprises on taxable income up to RMB 3 million; 100% super deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; accelerated depreciation for fixed assets; software enterprise preferential income-tax holidays; 5-year loss carryforward generally, extended to 10 years for high-technology and technology-advanced service enterprises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Resident Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form A100000) and related schedules, filed through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax filing portal (e-Tax).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual settlement of Corporate Income Tax, with quarterly provisional prepayments during the fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year is the calendar year; quarterly prepayment returns are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the annual CIT return and self-assessment, together with the annual related-party transaction form where applicable, are due by 31 May of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report all gross revenue from royalty-free stock music subscriptions, commercial soundscape licensing, synchronization fees, and other business turnover earned by the China WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include revenue recognized under PRC GAAP on a gross basis; do not net withholding tax or VAT. If the WFOE is acting merely as a pass-through platform for a Taiwan principal, tax authorities may look through the arrangement and attribute the revenue to the principal; the WFOE must therefore substantiate its own beneficial ownership of the licensing business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs attributable to producing, acquiring, or streaming audio content, licensed sample inventory, commissioned music production, platform hosting, and delivery infrastructure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All cross-border purchases or intragroup payments from Taiwan or related parties must satisfy the arm's length standard. Costs supported by invoices from shell suppliers or by non-contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation may be disallowed, especially in royalty-free audio licensing where intangible value is difficult to price.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: PRC VAT, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, stamp duty, and other deductible business taxes and surcharges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile VAT returns with the CIT return; export or cross-border audio licensing may qualify for VAT zero-rating or exemption only with proper documentation, but such treatment does not automatically exempt Corporate Income Tax on the profit. Non-creditable input VAT on entertainment and non-business expenses must be excluded from deductible taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 (Line 4/5/6) - Selling, General, Administrative and Financial Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, distribution, commissions, overhead, depreciation, amortization, impairment losses, and financing costs of the China WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party service fees must pass the benefit test; pure shareholder costs and duplicate management fees are not deductible. Interest paid to a Taiwan shareholder is subject to thin-capitalization limitations unless the WFOE proves arm's length debt and actual use of funds in China.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile accounting profit before income tax from the statutory financial statements to tax total profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE records artificially thin margins while the Taiwan parent retains the global residual profit from audio licensing, the tax authority may recharacterize the structure and allocate profit to China under the substance and transfer pricing rules. Include Schedule A105000 adjustments for non-deductible expenses and fair-value differences.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 (Line 17/18/19) - Tax Adjustments, Tax-Exempt Income and Deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Capture all tax-law reconciliation entries: disallowed expenses, timing differences, R&D super deductions, tax-exempt income, prior-year loss deductions, and treaty-related adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE as payer must withhold on cross-border dividends, interest, and royalties before remittance; treaty benefits apply only if the Taiwan recipient holds a valid Tax Residency Certificate and passes the beneficial ownership test. No dividend, interest, or royalty payment may be deducted from EIT merely because it is subject to WHT; the withholding and payment must be separately documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 (Line 24/25/26) - Taxable Income and Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after all adjustments, multiplied by the 25% headline rate, less preferential reductions and foreign tax credits, resulting in the net EIT payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If transfer pricing adjustments increase taxable income, the WFOE must pay the deficiency with interest and penalties; no corresponding downward adjustment is available in China for the Taiwan affiliate unless the tax authority agrees through mutual agreement procedure or an equivalent cross-strait tax arrangement. Verify that overpaid prepayments are credited and that the annual return matches the withholding returns.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; late payment incurs a daily surcharge of 0.05% (approximately 18.25% annually) from the due date. Under PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63, non-filing, underreporting, or false reporting that understates tax can result in recovery of the unpaid tax plus a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid amount; deliberate and large-scale concealment triggers criminal liability under PRC Criminal Law Article 201, with fines and imprisonment up to seven years. Serious tax violations are published on the tax blacklist, and legal representatives and directly responsible officers may be subjected to travel bans, exit restrictions, credit sanctions, and disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Prior to remitting dividends, interest, or royalties to a Taiwan-resident recipient, the China WFOE must determine whether the recipient is the beneficial owner and whether the PRC-Taiwan cross-strait tax arrangement applies. The mandatory protocol includes: (1) obtaining and retaining an original Taiwan Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) covering the year of payment; (2) completing the Chinese tax authority's treaty-benefit statement or beneficial-ownership declaration; (3) demonstrating substance in Taiwan, including real employees, management decisions, and business activity; (4) proving direct shareholding percentages and holding periods where reduced rates apply; and (5) filing the withholding return and supplemental schedules before or at the time of remittance. If treaty relief is not approved, the statutory 10% WHT must be withheld and remitted; a refund can be pursued only after filing the appropriate amended return and producing full documentary evidence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest income: statutory PRC WHT is 10% for non-resident enterprises, potentially reduced to a treaty rate for a Taiwan-beneficial owner under the cross-strait arrangement; Royalties: statutory PRC WHT is 10% for non-resident royalty income, potentially reduced to a treaty rate for a Taiwan-beneficial owner after treaty approval. Interest deductions are further restricted by thin capitalization and arm's length debt rules; royalty deductions require genuine audio-intangible ownership, transfer of rights, and beneficial ownership. Absent a treaty claim and approval, the full statutory 10% must be withheld on both interest and royalties.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: RMB: contemporaneous Local File documentation is mandatory when annual related-party tangible-asset transfers exceed RMB 200 million, intangible-asset transfers exceed RMB 100 million, financial-asset transfers exceed RMB 100 million, or aggregate other related-party transactions exceed RMB 40 million; Master File and CbC reporting obligations apply when the multinational group's consolidated revenue reaches the PRC threshold of RMB 5 billion or other applicable CbC/turnover thresholds are met. These thresholds also trigger the annual related-party transaction reporting form, transfer pricing contemporaneous documentation, and benchmark studies.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Although the PRC does not apply BVI-Cayman-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), it applies an equivalent Economic Substance Doctrine through the substance-over-form principle, the General Anti-Abuse Rule under CIT Law Article 47, the Special Tax Adjustment rules, and the beneficial ownership test. The WFOE must demonstrate Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) in China, including actual employees, physical and digital infrastructure, licensing contract execution, customer contracting, billing, collection, and risk control; the Taiwan shareholder must demonstrate substantive ownership and decision-making outside of China. A pure mailbox or conduit arrangement will be ignored or recharacterized, and treaty benefits will be denied.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through False Deductions and Inflated Royalty-Free Music Licensing Costs
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE records fabricated music-library purchases, inflated license-acquisition fees, or phantom production commissions paid to a Taiwan shell or nominal licensor, with no actual service or intangible asset transferred, thereby reducing mainland-China taxable profit or creating artificial losses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63, the tax authority recovers the underpaid CIT plus daily late-payment interest and imposes a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; if the amount and concealment meet criminal thresholds, PRC Criminal Law Article 201 applies and the case is referred for criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The directors, financial controller, and legal representative who signed or directed the false returns are treated as directly responsible persons; they face joint civil liability to restore the company's assets, public tax blacklisting, exit restrictions and travel bans, and criminal conviction carrying fines and fixed-term imprisonment of up to seven years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Beneficial Ownership Fraud and Treaty Shopping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Taiwan-resident company with no substantive management, employees, or business activity claims reduced dividend, interest, or royalty WHT under the cross-strait arrangement while acting only as a pass-through conduit for a third-country ultimate owner, or while remitting funds through Stripe/PayPal channels to obscure the true beneficiary.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The PRC tax authority denies treaty relief under the beneficial-ownership rule and GAAR (CIT Law Article 47 and SAT Public Notice 9/2018), recovers the 10% statutory WHT difference, imposes interest, and may impose a 50% to 500% penalty where intentional evasion is established; the payer also faces non-deduction of the underlying expense and an additional 5% daily late-payment surcharge.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of both the Taiwan and China entities who design or approve the conduit arrangement can be held personally liable for the unpaid tax as organizers of tax evasion; travel bans, blacklisting, and civil asset restitution may be imposed; if prosecuted under Criminal Law Article 201, the directly responsible officers face fines and imprisonment of up to seven years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold Enterprise Income Tax on Outbound Profit Repatriations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE remits dividends, shareholder interest, or stock-music royalties to the Taiwan parent or non-resident beneficiary without withholding the statutory 10% EIT, without filing the withholding return, or after misclassifying the payment as offshore e-commerce service revenue to avoid withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under PRC CIT Law Articles 37 and 38 and Tax Collection Administration Law Article 69, the withholding agent is liable for the unwithheld tax, must pay daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05%, and is subject to a fine of 50% to 300% of the unwithheld amount; the recipient remains liable for the underlying CIT if the WFOE cannot recover it.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and the responsible directors may be held civilly liable for the tax loss suffered by the WFOE; knowing or fraudulent failure to withhold exposes them to criminal prosecution for tax evasion, personal fines, public blacklisting, exit-control restrictions, and imprisonment of up to seven years.
